messages.subject: rbokeh shiny integration
parts:
Hi,

I came across this post that says rbokeh shiny integration is complete!! 

https://github.com/bokeh/rbokeh/issues/25

But when I try the two examples near the end of the page, all I get is blank pages in the browser window. What am I doing wrong?

When I run the example posted by 'hafen', the only messages I get are:

Listening on http://127.0.0.1:3807
xlim not specified explicitly... calculating...
ylim not specified explicitly... calculating...

Jonathan

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: rbokeh shiny integration
parts:
You might need to update your copies of jsonlite, shiny, and htmlwidgets, as some low-level infrastructure across those packages have changed lately:

install.packages("jsonlite")
devtools::install_github(c("ramnathv/htmlwidgets", "rstudio/shiny"))
